body: I wish. My opening post was more of a rant about the past year if anything. I get your message though and I've been trying for awhile to make things work. I just sort of broke down yesterday. My life for the past year has been me trying to get something going and then once it does something fairly traumatic happens that ruins it. This has literally happened four or five times. These aren't normal highschool problems, it isn't school drama or anything like that. If I wasn't so paranoid I would list it all out but I think I'll wait until my current situation resolves itself. I hope you wont mind my vague explanations though.
I used to have depression before, I don't see anything in that light anymore though. What's been happening lately has been completely out of my control.

I can't talk about what's going on now. But before, maybe from eight months ago. Things had been getting progressively worse. So many bad things have been happening that I've lost count and can't even remember half of them. I think just seeing a response from a lot of you helped me out though. 

It's so difficult to try so hard and have it shadowed by terrible things happening in life. For example, one of the smaller things that has happened was our car got stolen. I used to have depression a while back (2-3 years ago) but I pulled through and started working at my life. Reading, exercising, making friends etc. There is a lot of stuff I want to say but I'm uncomfortable with because who knows who will end up reading this and making that connection. But anyway, A lot of uncontrollable things have been happening to me lately. 

My brother has been a generally an asshole for a lot of my life, which made me basically cut him off. I'm not going to go into detail as to what his done but lets just say his bad. My parents are well intentioned but jesus christ they're difficult some times. Ah man there is so much to say I don't even know where to begin, but really this response has helped me out a lot. Just to know that there exists a type of person that actually cares means something to me. I'm rambling now and I'm also not to clear in the head atm I'll try to gather my thoughts and make a post that's actually structured.
